text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In the end, we couldn't send those girls out...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, it would have been the same result with me,
so please don't say that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the wind of passion that you stirred, Trainer,
must have breathed at least a gentle breeze
within that glass."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Drawing strength from that, I pray that one day, everyone will be able to feel the wind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
